name: NCR Atleos
description: NCR Atleos has built the world's largest retail ATM network—a powerful, purpose-built platform to help financial institutions expand their presence beyond their physical branches. Our ATM network is your platform for growth and service differentiation. From Allpoint, the largest surcharge-free ATM network, to ReadyCode, the cardless way to deliver cash access, NCR Atleos extends delivery of ATM services beyond the branch and into customers' daily lives. Our ATM network is quick, convenient and cost effective, supporting growth and branch transformation initiatives for you, and a better banking experience for your customers. We operate 280K+ ATMs globally, with 55K Allpoint ATMs providing access to 60M consumers. Our ATM branding delivers a differentiated ATM program that builds brand and enhances service delivery. ReadyCode disconnects the card from digital account access, enabling consumers to access cash and receive cash payments from virtually any digital account with a simple numeric code at tens of thousands of ATMs. NCR Atleos LocatorSearch is a leading location services tool with both web and mobile applications that seamlessly displays locations in a modern, customizable interface.
